configuration.path_energy_convention: fixed omega along the full Eq. (B.2) chord

svg.color_scale: log10 escaped_luminosity_fraction_within_region; values below 1e-8 of maximum clipped

energy_grid_equivalence.comparison_method: invert archived B.1 spectral_measure_MeV3 = E^2 sqrt(E^2-m^2)/(2 pi^2)

interpretation_limits: The result uses the literal fixed-omega Eq. (B.2) baseline and the archived public-figure reconstructed SFHo-18.8 profile.
This is an escape-distribution decomposition, not a correction or rescaling of the published curve.
The phase-space bins are post-processing partitions of the same high-order source and opacity arrays; no new physical approximation is introduced.
The energy bins are reporting bins only and do not alter the underlying quadrature.
No axial-vector output or constraint curve is changed.

profile.identity: reconstructed public-figure SFHo-18.8, t_pb=1 s profile; not original Garching raw table

title: High-order B.16 10 MeV escaping phase-space decomposition
